story_ai.headline: GIFT Nifty signals a 150‑point gap‑down as global markets tumble
paragraphs: GIFT Nifty is at 25316.5, down 163.5 points (-0.6%). The index implies a gap‑down of about -197.8 points (-0.8%) versus Nifty’s last close of 25514.3, a historically sensitive signal for the open.

Overnight, US futures show the S&P 500 fut at 7177.0 (-0.3%), Nasdaq fut 26422.5 (-0.7%) and Dow fut 49161.0 (-0.0%). Asian markets are sharply lower: Nikkei 56775.0 (-4.5%), Kospi 4903.9 (-4.6%), Hang Seng 22389.8 (-2.0%), Shanghai 3510.8 (-1.9%) and Taiwan 36173.1 (-5.9%). Europe closed softer with FTSE 100 at 10452.7 (-0.9%) and DAX at 25463.8 (-1.1%).

Commodities: Brent 90.0 up 0.6%, WTI 82.9 up 0.6%; Gold 3550.1 down 3.7%, Silver 42.0 down 5.4%, Copper 5.5 down 1.8%, Natural gas 3.2 down 0.8%. Currency: USD/INR steady at 93.28, Dollar index 103.9 flat, US 10Y yield 5.1 down 0.3 bps. The dip in copper and weak US tech outlook may weigh on Indian metals and IT sectors.
